roth_szabo_macdonald_2023.citation: C. Roth, A. Szabo, and A. H. MacDonald, High-accuracy variational Monte Carlo for frustrated magnets with deep neural networks, arXiv:2211.07749

spin_purity_audit_20261101.locations: Section II.1 spin-flip parity, Table III ground-state total-spin diagnostics
spin_purity_audit_20261101.reported_quantity: Expectation of S_tot squared, not a definite nonzero total-spin quantum number
spin_purity_audit_20261101.normalization: Entire-system <(sum_i S_i)^2>, not divided by N or N squared. The per-spin unit in the table captions applies to energy only.
spin_purity_audit_20261101.size_trend: Section III.1 reports consistently higher S2 for larger measured square-lattice sizes and J2; triangular Table III likewise rises from N36 to N108. This motivates a large-size audit but is not a theorem of monotonicity at an unreported N144 or for different optimization qualities.
spin_purity_audit_20261101.small_system_calibration_limit: The archived N16 demonstration isolates sector versus within-sector errors. It does not establish harmless contamination in N108/N144 GCNN states or in the thermodynamic limit.

reported_values.status: not reported; absence is not evidence of a measured nonzero value

derived_bound_not_a_claim_from_the_paper.conditions: Normalized fixed-M0 ground state with exact even spin-flip parity on these N divisible by4 clusters
derived_bound_not_a_claim_from_the_paper.formula: p(non-S0)<=min(1,<S_tot^2>/6); without this parity only /2 is guaranteed
derived_bound_not_a_claim_from_the_paper.warning: Upper bounds on non-S0 weight, not measured weights or fidelity to the exact ground state. Statistical uncertainty and within-singlet variational errors remain separate.

spin_purity_audit_20261101.interpretation: Spin contamination warrants observable-specific and sector-resolved audits. It does not logically invalidate every scalar correlation or prove erroneous phase conclusions. Exact SU(2) alone does not certify state accuracy, magnetic order, or a QSL.

L12_descriptive_raw_fit.warning: Backward extrapolation outside all source sizes, NOT interpolation, certified target, SOTA measurement or confidence interval. Window spread and model residuals dominate the tabulated statistical SE.

viteritti_rende_sachdev_carleo_2026.capacity_context: Paper d72/h12/depth8 about450k parameters; our ongoing same-model N144 run100288 real parameters. Capacity differences alone do not diagnose optimization saturation.
